props.heading: capturing QRUE PLUS
props.text:
This project documents the QRUE PLUS event at Kühlhaus Flensburg, where I was responsible for filming the live performance in an indoor concert setting with a deliberately minimal equipment setup. The production environment came with initial technical challenges, particularly regarding audio capture and room acoustics.

Despite these constraints, I focused on maximizing the available resources to deliver the highest possible audiovisual quality. Through adaptive on-site decision-making and careful post-production work, the final result preserves the raw energy of the event while maintaining a clean and usable sound and image representation of the performance.
